summary:
w145 (formulation#r14) reviewed: commit 97299dc (a rebase of the a8a59c7 the implementer lists by work run, with the same content). It touches only SKILL.md and initiative-round.md, both in the fileset. No change under features/ or tests/, no tests removed or weakened, no allowance rows.
The Small-Change Path and the 'talking to you' section are gone; glossary rewording now happens in a formulate round with no gate, as r14 and decision 0068 ask.
tools check: nothing to check / no import contracts; tools size: none over 300.
Observations, none fix now: (Important) checking-spec-consistency SKILL l.57-64 and spec-consistency#r6 still name the removed small-change path; (Minor) the Hand-back Template l.114 still has a session write the feature file; (Minor) a step reword in a capability outside the proposal gets no work-item to turn it green.
